name: print-social-black-and-yellow-power-tool-ad-set-with-spec-callouts
title: Six black and yellow power-drill ads with big condensed headlines, macro photos and spec callouts
whatItIs: A grid of dark ads for a yellow drill: headlines like 'MAXIMUM TORQUE TOTAL CONTROL', 'HIGH PERFORMANCE POWER', '2,000 RPM POWER AT FULL SPEED', close-ups of gloved hands and the drill, spec callouts with thin lines and a yellow angled panel.
whatItMeans: Rugged and confident; the yellow product pops from black photography.
techniques: Use black photography with yellow highlights.
Add thin callout lines to features.
Include a yellow angled panel for a spec.

vocabulary.definition: A label with a thin line to a feature.
A slanted colour block behind text.
